question: How much do PCC predictions of initially unlabeled nodes change between a prospectively fixed mid-run and terminal observation under a fixed unmodified graph and label budget, as a descriptive within-backend convergence trajectory?

historical_overlap.rule: exclude all from any claim of fresh confirmatory validation; other previously viewed datasets require declaration before freeze
historical_overlap.policy: historical thresholds, seeds, outcome-selected examples, and hashes are not carried forward

eligibility_proposed.source: public third-party dataset with immutable version and license recorded
eligibility_proposed.feature_policy: finite numeric features with fully frozen missing-value and scaling treatment
eligibility_proposed.graph: undirected symmetric active-neighbor adjacency, dense padded neib_list; freeze ordering, graph k and normalization before inspecting PCC results

dataset_registry.selection_policy: A fixed registry of eligible candidates and deterministic, outcome-blind selection order must be sealed by an independent reviewer before any model fit; no dataset substitution after outcomes. Three is a target, not a claim of selected datasets.

experimental_design.generator_proposed: NumPy Generator(PCG64(SeedSequence([P1_NAMESPACE_INTEGER, dataset_registry_index, replicate_index]))) used only once to choose uniformly without replacement within each sorted original class; do not consume the propagation RNG.
experimental_design.label_policy: same frozen label mask, home-node sorted order and graph for every backend within dataset x replicate; all other nodes receive -1; P2 must seal each label mask hash
experimental_design.seed_policy: PROPOSED only: for candidate registry order [212,850,292], mask RNG SeedSequence([20261112, registry_index, replicate_index]), with PCG64 used only to sample 3/class distinct original row IDs in source-class sorted order. Separately derive native propagation seed as 1 + (LE_uint32(SHA256('pypcc-P1-propagation-v1|uci:<dataset_id>|mask:<replicate>|<backend_name>')[:4]) % (2**32-1)). Backend-specific nonzero uint32 seeds preserve native RNG differences; independent reviewer must freeze registry order, exact mask implementation/NumPy version, 72 seed table, graph/mask hashes before real fits.
experimental_design.graph_policy: Build once per dataset using the unchanged production topology and preprocessing; seal the exact ordered symmetric undirected graph; preserve intentionally dense padded neib_list with no sparse/CSR substitution
experimental_design.stop_rule: no early stop in proposed fixed-horizon descriptive trajectory protocol; no stopping-rule comparison

limits.export_bytes_and_cpu: P2 MUST estimate before approval; do not run when any cap is exceeded

primary.name: per_backend_unlabeled_prediction_flip_fraction
primary.numerator: number of initially unlabeled nodes whose argmax class at 5000 differs from argmax class at 50000
primary.denominator: number of initially unlabeled nodes (excluding originally labeled nodes only)
primary.unit: dataset x frozen label mask x backend
primary.ties: argmax deterministic first-index convention; exact ties remain in the denominator, with tied-row fraction reported separately
primary.summary: report each backend separately: dataset-level average across mask replicates, then unweighted mean across eligible datasets
primary.uncertainty: PROPOSED exploratory descriptive only: show all 8 masks per dataset/backend, mask mean/median/min/max and unweighted mean across 3 dataset means; NO 95% confidence interval, p-value, equivalence or population generalization claim from 3 deliberately selected domains or node-level pseudo-replicates. A separate confirmatory protocol would require independent datasets, practical-effect thresholds and justified cluster-aware uncertainty before seeing results.

secondary.name: balanced_accuracy_change
secondary.description: balanced accuracy on initially unlabeled nodes at 50000 minus at 5000, using oracle ground truth only in retrospective evaluator; report classes with zero support as non-evaluable

secondary.name: global_accuracy_change
secondary.description: accuracy delta on initially unlabeled nodes, 50000 minus 5000

secondary.name: exact_tie_fraction_at_each_milestone
secondary.description: fraction of initially unlabeled nodes with exactly tied maximum dominance, using strict bitwise equality within backend

secondary.name: dominance_margin_change
secondary.description: median within-run change of top-two dominance margin between 5000 and 50000 (not calibrated probability)

secondary.name: full_trajectory
secondary.description: class-prediction change and dominance diagnostics at every predeclared milestone; descriptive, no selective milestone search

estimands.multiplicity: one descriptive primary per backend; report all backends and all prespecified secondary metrics, no selective significance thresholds

analysis_plan.aggregation: nodes nested in fixed label masks, masks nested in datasets; backends paired by same masks but distinct RNG and arithmetic; do not treat nodes or backend conditions as independent dataset replicates
analysis_plan.missingness: any failed fit, inaccessible milestone, memory-cap block or invalid provenance reported with reason and denominator; no silently dropped outcome or automatic retry
analysis_plan.decision_logic: Exploratory P1: report complete prespecified descriptive changes, no binary support/rejection, p-value, equivalence claim or confidence interval. Missing/failed cases remain in append-only attempt ledger; withhold an unqualified 72-case aggregate until a separate reviewed missingness disposition. Confirmatory thresholds and interval method need an independently approved FUTURE protocol.
analysis_plan.oracle_access: retrospective scoring only; forbidden during seed/mask/graph/milestone/backend choice
analysis_plan.raw_audit: append-only attempt records, exact hashes and classifications for negative, ambiguous and non-evaluable results

required_before_P1_freeze: prospectively selected and independently reviewed dataset registry, versions, licensing, and historical exposure audit
exact feature preprocessing and graph generation/ordering/topology parameters per dataset
seed-policy finalization with explicit generated label masks and unique propagation seeds

explicit reviewer approval of exploratory-only descriptive estimands (all 8 masks and backend-stratified domain summaries, no significance/CI/equivalence), tie and non-evaluability handling; any confirmatory claim needs a separate preregistration
approval of sample size/resource rationale and observation milestone schedule before any outcome inspection
maintainer explicit approval and signed/sealed new immutable P1 payload
required_before_any_real_fit: frozen P1 scientific protocol reviewed independently
separate per-backend P2 current-source compiled binary, environment and fixture preflight
verified P2 memory/CPU/disk/export budget and source/graph/mask hashes
explicit maintainer approval of new P2 execution-specific SHA
